datasets.title: Lebanon Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 781.4 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 61% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 1% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap and validated against AI-mapped estimates to assess coverage completeness (approximately 61% of total buildings). Data quality metrics include average age of 2 years with recent updates in the last 6 months, provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for exposure assessment.
